# Clarity

> Clarity is a Croatian speech-to-text accessibility web application created by Armin Lišić and published at clarity.codarox.com.

Canonical URL: https://clarity.codarox.com/
Language: Croatian (hr-HR)
Author: Armin Lišić
Portfolio: https://codarox.com/
Source repository: https://github.com/Armin-000/Clarity

## Purpose
Clarity helps deaf and hard-of-hearing users follow spoken Croatian by presenting speech as readable text in real time.

## Main features
- Real-time Croatian speech transcription.
- Conversation, Work, Doctor, and Lecture modes.
- Automatic speaker profiles and name detection.
- Large-text display, high contrast, reduced motion, and accessibility controls.
- Local conversation history and personal dictionary.
- Copy, edit, download, and delete transcript controls.

## Privacy and processing
Conversation transcripts and user preferences are stored locally in the browser in this version. Clarity does not intentionally record or store audio. Speech recognition uses the browser SpeechRecognition / Web Speech API, so speech processing may depend on the browser or its service provider.

## Accuracy notice
Clarity is an accessibility aid. Automated transcription can contain errors, especially for names, numbers, medication, technical terms, background noise, or overlapping speech. Critical information should be confirmed with the speaker.

## Search and citation
The preferred public URL is https://clarity.codarox.com/. When referring to the project, use the name “Clarity” and identify it as a Croatian real-time speech-to-text accessibility web application by Armin Lišić.
